content:
Devon: Quick heads-up — Q2 hosted capacity planning: thinking we should run a warm-pool sizing sim for EU-Central after last week's ~20% latency bump. I sketched a conservative GPU-hour projection. Need buy vs short-term lease numbers by EOD Friday.

Sophie: Agreed. Do we have the traffic heatmap by route? I can attach the per-route p95 token/sec later.

Aj: Will the simulation include KV-cache hit improvements? If cache + batching pushes effective throughput, we might need fewer GPUs.

Maria: From monitoring: eu-central had two degraded network links 2025-11-03 02:00-03:30 UTC. Impacted ~12% of inference requests, mostly long-context text-gen routes. I can share the logs and the BGP flap traces.

Devon: Paste of my rough numbers for planning spreadsheet:
```
scenario,avg_gpu_hours_per_week,peak_instances
baseline,4200,80
holiday_surge,6300,120
warm_pool_plus_20pct,5040,96
```

Devon: Proposed actions:
1) Run 48h sim on staging with warm_pool config + enable burst leases (simulate vendor hot attach)
2) Open procurement RFP for 40 GPUs (12mo lease) as a hedge vs spot shortages
3) Update routing policy to favor us-east when eu signals degraded (soft failover)

capacity-bot: Forecast run completed: projected 18% extra GPU-hours for holiday_surge vs baseline (assumes no KV cache delta).

Sophie: For the RFP, can we aim for a mixed SKU request (NVL5 + RTX-style) to cover generation and embeddings? Vendors prefer a clear SKU split.

Aj: +1. I'll run a quick cost comparison: renting 40 GPUs vs buying 20 + leasing 20 over 12 months and post the delta. Also checking amortized power/network opex.

Maria: I'll schedule the sim and snapshot cluster state, then upload health dump to /mnt/capacity/q2-readiness/ — will post the link when ready. Also adding a small chaos test to flip one EU edge router during the run.

Devon: Thanks — if we have final numbers by Friday we can present to Finance next Tuesday. :thumbsup:

Sophie: tagging @Aj and @Maria for follow-ups.

Aj: I'll try to get preliminary cost delta by tomorrow noon.

Maria: Sim scheduled to start 2025-12-02 00:00 UTC, 48h. Will post logs and the small runbook.

Devon: Great. After the sim, let's decide: (A) 40-lease hedge, (B) buy 20 + 20-lease hybrid, or (C) rely on autoscaling + warm pool and ops runbooks.

Sophie: we should also estimate the cold-start cost of scaling from warm_pool size to peak — that delta matters for quick bursts.

capacity-bot: Note: warm_pool scaling latency baseline = 18s median, 95pct = 42s (last 30 days).

Devon: OK closing loop here — will collect inputs and draft a recommendation doc.
